fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`uniqify_cards` in `discordbot/command.py` deduplicates cards using only the canonical card name as the dictionary key. When a user asked for the same card with multiple different set-code suffixes — e.g. `[[Vindicate|G07]]`, `[[Vindicate|J13]]`, `[[Vindicate|MP2]]` — all three resolved to the same key `"vindicate"`, so only the last one survived.

## What changed

The deduplication key in `uniqify_cards` now includes the `preferred_printing` field: `card.canonicalize(c.name) + '|' + (c.get('preferred_printing') or '')`. Cards with no explicit printing still share a key (the empty-string suffix) and are correctly deduplicated; cards with different explicit set codes produce distinct keys and are all preserved.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit discordbot` — 851 passed, 1 skipped (full suite, with 3 new unit tests for `uniqify_cards` covering: no-printing deduplication, same-printing deduplication, and distinct-printing preservation)

Fixes #10531
fix.pr_title: Fix uniqify_cards to preserve multiple explicit set-code printings (#10531)
